item.title: RydeeNLP: Personalized Japanese Learning with NLP
item.description:
RydeeNLP is a Japanese language learning system that integrates NLP techniques with educational technology to provide personalized learning experiences.

  • A word-swapping model creates a multi-tiered difficulty classification for Japanese nouns, verbs and adjectives.
  • Custom difficulty and paraphrase dictionaries inform adaptive translation models that adjust translations to the learner’s proficiency.
  • A web browser extension provides real-time, proficiency-matched translations and automatically populates a spaced-repetition flashcard system.

The work was presented at the ACM SIGCSE Technical Symposium 2025 Student Research Competition in Pittsburgh, PA.
